replacements.p1-r2: RAG-based Business-Specialized Real-Time Multilingual Translation and Interpretation AI Solution Development: A Global Sales, Consulting, Interpretation, and Document Automation Integrated Platform for SME Export Sales Innovation
replacements.p1-r4: Develop a RAG-based multilingual translation model and real-time streaming voice interpretation model (more than 8 languages) that implements business-specialized AI models by learning company-specific product names, technical specifications, and prices. Develop automation agents for export documents like estimates and product pages throughout the export process. Establish a platform integrating unique regulatory certification formatting (eCTD, KC, CE, FCC, etc.) modules to eliminate global entry barriers for SMEs and realize sales innovation.
replacements.p1-r6: Establish overwhelming entry barriers through domain-specific fine-tuning using a core proprietary corpus of 1.1 million sentence pairs, 600,000 business, and 500,000 regulatory certifications that cannot be replicated in a short period. [AI Model Advancement] Enhance hallucination reduction by 70% by combining RAG technology introducing company-specific knowledge into a hybrid language model based on NLLB/EXAONE. Achieve simultaneous interpretation performance within seconds of delay using InfiniSST and Whisper-based technologies. [SaaS Platform Commercialization] Develop a cloud SaaS web, mobile, and API integrated environment that allows client companies to use their data within 3 days without IT personnel through the verified AI platform (Oz-i) infrastructure of the leading organization.
replacements.p2-r0:
[Principal] PCN Co., Ltd. (Platform/Commercialization Overall): An AI company with 25 years of experience (sales of 27 billion KRW) owning the Oz-i AI platform and various R&D business expertise, guaranteeing SaaS platform construction, API integration, and cloud infrastructure commercialization.
[Joint①] Stunning Box Co., Ltd. (AI Model/Data Dedicated): An AI translation data company that has accumulated professional datasets over 15 years, responsible for AI translation fine-tuning and core asset proprietary corpus supply, and multi-agent regulatory certification formatting technology.
[Joint②] Three Client Companies (Field Empirical Verification): Companies such as Sunlight Illucom Co., Ltd. (auto parts), Genuine Grip Co., Ltd. (special footwear), Grey Whale (K-Beauty), which have won top export awards, provide empirical data for three different industries and quantitatively verify introduction effects through A/B testing.
replacements.p2-r2:
[Economic·Industrial Impact] Enhance client companies' export contract winning rate by more than 20% and drastically reduce regulatory certification document processing time from 4-8 weeks to 1-2 weeks. Create 51 new jobs, achieve 22 billion KRW in sales in the 5th year of commercialization (cumulative 68 billion KRW in 5 years), and plan to provide more than 500 SMEs with AI vouchers and KOTRA links. Achieve a cumulative export substitution effect of 44 billion KRW over 5 years.
[Achievement of World-Class Technology] Achieve a translation accuracy of BLEU 65 or higher, simultaneous interpretation delay within 2 seconds, and a document structure preservation rate (TEDS) of 70% or more, thereby preoccupying the B2B domain specialized translation market that global big tech (Google·DeepL) could not solve.

replacements.p4-r87: 1) Background and Necessity of Business Promotion
replacements.p4-r89: Export SMEs face multiple barriers in overseas business operations due to translation that does not reflect company-specific contexts, interpretation structures unsuitable for real-time consulting, and high-cost and long-duration regulatory certification document handling. Therefore, an AI platform specialized in domains is needed that goes beyond simple translation functions to connect the entire export operation cycle based on company data and technical terminology.
replacements.p4-r94: Generic AI fails to adequately reflect product names, technical specifications, prices, and contract terms specific to companies, leading to risks of critical information misinterpretation during negotiation and contracting processes.
replacements.p4-r95: Connect company-specific product DB, price lists, and terminologies with RAG to reflect them in real-time for translation, interpretation, and document creation.
replacements.p4-r97: The existing STT→MT→TTS three-stage structure has a cumulative delay of 2-5 seconds or more, with limitations in handling background noise, speaker separation, and technical terminology processing.
replacements.p4-r98: Implement interpretation within 2 seconds using E2E streaming interpretation architecture, speaker separation, and technical terminology infusion.
replacements.p4-r100: CE·eCTD·FCC·HACCP formats and document structures are complex and vary by country, making the preparation time and outsourcing costs a huge burden for SMEs.
replacements.p4-r101: Automate the translation, structuring, and formatting of regulatory documents, and support document creation based on expert review (HITL).
replacements.p4-r103: ◦ The global business AI translation market is expected to grow from approximately 1.8 billion dollars in 2025 to over 7 billion dollars in 2030, with rapidly expanding demand for specialized business domains.
